verdict.rationale: Kong documents an on-prem configuration path using AI plugins on Services and Routes, a self-run data plane that can run in Docker with local log paths, and a hybrid architecture in which the control plane stays out of the data path. Together these show customers can run the gateway themselves. However, the newer AI Gateway 2.x model appears tied to a Konnect control plane, and the self-host details are thin. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the control plane can be fully self-hosted for 2.x, licensing/open-source terms for self-hosting, and independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.
